subject.title: feat(android): add Wear OS app MVP

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt and maintain this first-party Wear OS companion app after the remaining security, gate, auth, license, and proof blockers are fixed?
rationale: The branch adds a large native app surface with auth, network, storage, notifications, tiles, complications, and release ownership; code review can identify blockers, but only maintainers can decide whether core should own this product surface and who sponsors it.

options.title: Adopt with Android owner sponsorship
options.body: Keep this PR as the canonical Wear app candidate, require the listed blockers and real-device proof before merge, and have an Android owner sponsor the final shape.

options.title: Split foundations from UI
options.body: Extract only shared gateway/proxy primitives maintainers want, then defer the Wear UI to a smaller follow-up or external app.

options.title: Close as not core-owned
options.body: Close the first-party Wear app proposal if maintainers do not want to own native Wear support in this repository now.

recommendation.title: Adopt with Android owner sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the canonical Wear app candidate, require the listed blockers and real-device proof before merge, and have an Android owner sponsor the final shape.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to obviyus and the decision is primarily about whether the Android app area should adopt this Wear surface.
